remove_definitions(-D_WIN32_WINNT=0x502 -DWINVER=0x502)

add_definitions(
    -D__WINESRC__
    -D__ROS_LONG64__
    -D_WIN32_WINNT=0x0600
    -DWINVER=0x0600)

spec2def(amstream.dll amstream.spec)

add_idl_reg_objects(amstream registry amstream_classes.idl)

# amstream.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/amstream-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
# Generated inputs those compiles read, ordered before them.
add_library(amstream_shims OBJECT audiodata.c audiostream.c ddrawstream.c filter.c main.c multimedia.c)
target_link_libraries(amstream_shims PRIVATE wine wine_dll_register wine_dll_canunload strmbase strmiids uuid libole32 libadvapi32 libddraw libuser32 libkernel32_vista libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module(amstream_shims)
add_dependencies(amstream_shims wineheaders)
set(AMSTREAM_REUSED
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/dll/directx/wine/amstream/amstream_classes_r.o)
add_cargo_module(amstream amstream-cargo amstream.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS amstream_shims psdk amstream_r ${AMSTREAM_REUSED} dxsdk uuid_sources)
